summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Twogether MVP. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests PASS (auth register/login/duplicate/wrong-password, /me, public-key update, pair create idempotent, redeem invalid/self/already-active, active-pair GET with partner info incl. public_key, messages E2E ciphertext-only + after-filter, worries create/list/resolve, events create/list/delete, and 'Not paired' 400 for messages/worries/events). Frontend: Welcome->Register->Pair->Chat E2E flow fully verified in mobile viewport 390x844 including create-invite code display, remote redeem, auto-navigation to tabs on active pair, chat send with real NaCl E2E round-trip visible in feed, and server-side ciphertext-only storage (no plaintext leak confirmed via API). Calendar, Worries, and Us (profile) tabs render correctly with paired state and 'Disconnect from partner' + 'Sign out' visible. Wrong-password login shows 'Incorrect email or password' error. No React Native red screens, no deprecated packages detected (uses expo-audio/expo-video not expo-av).

issues: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' — informational only, no user impact but should be cleaned up in a future pass.

action_items: (Optional) Silence RN Web console warnings by replacing legacy shadow* style props with boxShadow and removing props.pointerEvents in favor of style.pointerEvents.

(Optional) Note that pydantic EmailStr rejects the reserved '.test' TLD used in /app/memory/test_credentials.md sample emails (alice@twogether.test / bob@twogether.test) — real registration with those literal emails will 422. Consider updating the sample to a non-reserved domain (e.g. @twogether-app.com) so future testers can reuse the doc as-is.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/pair/redeem returns 400 'You cannot pair with yourself' correctly but only when the redeeming user already has a pending pair with themselves; a fresh user redeeming their own code path is also covered because pair_create writes user_a=user['id']. Verified working.
server.py: JWT_SECRET has a safe fallback but is set via env — good. Password hashing correctly truncates to 72 bytes (bcrypt limit). password_hash and _id are never exposed via public_user().
server.py: messages/worries/events all correctly gated by require_active_pair() returning 400 'Not paired'.
server.py: uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — will emit a DeprecationWarning; migrate to FastAPI 'lifespan' handlers (not blocking).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (welcome, register, pair-create, pair-redeem-remote, chat-e2e, calendar, worries, profile, wrong-password all pass)

seed_data_creation: Tests self-provision fresh TEST_* users per run; two paired accounts were created via API for frontend flow (TEST_a_*/TEST_b_* @twogether-web.com, password: secret123). No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and run under xdist with -n 2 loadscope. Use domain @twogether-web.com (NOT @twogether.test — reserved TLD is rejected by pydantic EmailStr). For frontend flows requiring an active pair, pre-provision partner via API and pair them, then log in as A to skip the pair screen. Chat/worries poll every 3s so allow a small wait after mutations.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. Only cosmetic RN Web deprecation warnings and a doc-vs-validation mismatch (reserved .test TLD in test_credentials.md) — flagged as optional cleanup.
